title: Transcranial Ultrasound Via Sonolucent Cranioplasty
summary: Transcranial Ultrasound via Sonolucent Cranioplasty is a prospective, single arm, observational, open label (non-blinded) study to collect real world evidence on the use of transcranial ultrasound via sonolucent cranioplasty.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Provision of signed and dated informed consent form.
2. Stated willingness to comply with all study procedures and availability for the duration of the study.
3. Patients who are undergoing reconstructive sonolucent cranioplasty as standard of care.
4. Male or female, aged ≥ 18.

Exclusion Criteria:

1\. Patients who are pregnant
